description: A QA engineer filed bug report #4729: 'The normalize_whitespace function in src/text_utils.py crashes when processing empty input strings.' Your task is to write a failing test in tests/test_text_utils.py that reproduces this bug. Specifically: (1) Add a new test function named test_normalize_empty_string_bug (or similar name containing 'empty' or 'bug') after the existing tests and TODO comment, (2) The test should call normalize_whitespace with empty string input like normalize_whitespace('') or normalize_whitespace('   ') to trigger the bug, (3) Add a docstring to the test explaining it tests Bug #4729 for empty string handling, (4) Add a comment noting the test currently fails due to IndexError, (5) Save the file, and (6) Run the test using: pytest tests/test_text_utils.py::test_normalize_empty_string_bug -v in the terminal to verify it fails and reproduces the bug. The test should demonstrate that the function crashes when strip() returns an empty string.
